title: QA/QC Civil Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 - Preparation of Project Quality Plan (PQP). - Preparation of Inspection & test Plans (ITP) - Inspection as per ITP - Performing Quality Surveillance for site activities - Identify ad report Non conformance - Closure of non conformance. - Co ordinating and performing Inspection as per ITP along with site construction person and customer/ consultant. - Monitoring repair statistics. - Getting repair attended by construction persons. - Accountable for compliance to project Quality requirements 
 Perks and benefits 
 - Free Visa - Free Food and Accommodation - No hidden Taxes - Free Insurance 
 Location - Sierra Leone, West Africa Project - Combined Cycle power plant 
 Interested Candidates can Email CV at Epc.recruit@shapoorji.com with subject line mention the position applied .

Key Skills: Power Plant,Civil,Qa/Qc,Industrial Construction,Quality assurance,Industrial,Construction,QC
